title: Aster raises $34M in Series A funding
excerpt: Aster, a San Francisco-based software company, raised $34M in Series A funding led by Cedar Capital and Maple Ventures.
body: Aster builds AI tools for community organizers. The software helps local groups plan activities and coordinate volunteers. Aster, a San Francisco-based software company, raised $34M in Series A funding led by Cedar Capital and Maple Ventures. The founders started the company in 2024.
